facts.heading: WHERE IT BEGAN
facts.body: United States led in 1900 with 664.1 million tonnes of annual co2 emissions - 33.8% of everything recorded that year.

facts.heading: THE RECORDED TOTAL
facts.body: Across the period the combined total went from 1.96 billion to 37.14 billion tonnes - about 19x.

facts.heading: CHINA TAKES THE LEAD
facts.body: China overtook United States in 2006 at 6.49 billion tonnes.

facts.heading: BIGGEST SINGLE-YEAR JUMP
facts.body: The largest one-year rise in the pool is China in 2011, up 910.1 million tonnes.

facts.heading: FASTEST RISER
facts.body: South Korea multiplied its annual co2 emissions by 757,042x over the period, reaching 583.7 million tonnes.

facts.heading: WHERE IT STANDS
facts.body: China tops the 2024 table at 12.29 billion tonnes, 33.1% of the recorded total.
